1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in a ventilation grill__.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

11. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __and a ventilation grill__.

13. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill, __wherein the ventilation grill is configured to cover an opening through which cooled air flows__.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: in a [[means for mounting within a structure wall, a means for evaporatively cooling an indoor area]] __housing mountable within a structure wall between wall studs, an evaporative cooling system for cooling an indoor area, the evaporative cooling system including a water reservoir, a pump, a pad, a water distributor, a motor, and a fan__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the [[means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling]] __housing is placed__ between wall studs spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.
